interventions.description: Install flush-mounted tree grates to provide a continuous, level walking surface while still allowing water and air to reach the tree roots.

interventions.title: Install physical buffers
interventions.description: Adding planters, bollards, or a protected bike lane would provide a necessary safety buffer between the wide sidewalk and the travel lanes.

interventions.title: Lane markings and narrowing
interventions.description: Painting clear lane lines and using road diets to narrow the perceived travel way can help reduce vehicle speeds.

interventions.title: Vertical Separation
interventions.description: Install bollards or a raised planter buffer to physically protect pedestrians from potential vehicle incursions.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crossing
interventions.description: Install a marked mid-block crossing with appropriate signage if this location serves as a key pedestrian link between the city and the waterfront.

interventions.title: Lane Narrowing / Road Diet
interventions.description: Reduce the width of travel lanes to slow traffic and provide space for other modes like cycling.

interventions.title: Slip-resistant surface treatment
interventions.description: Apply a non-slip coating to the metal expansion joint to prevent falls during wet weather.

interventions.title: Urban Greening
interventions.description: Introduce planters or trees to provide shade and improve the aesthetic quality of the large paved area.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Scale Lighting
interventions.description: While ornamental lighting exists, ensuring consistent, high-quality illumination specifically for the walkway improves perceived and actual safety.

interventions.title: Physical Barriers
interventions.description: Install crash-rated bollards or planters along the curb to provide a physical buffer between the sidewalk and the travel lanes.

interventions.title: Add Street Trees or Planters
interventions.description: Incorporate vegetation to provide shade, reduce the heat island effect, and improve the aesthetic quality of the wide walkway.
